items.question: Trong câu "Quick reminder: a singly linked list is a chain of nodes where each node holds a value and a next pointer, plus head, tail and length on the list.", từ "reminder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick reminder: a singly linked list is a chain of nodes where each node holds a value and a next pointer, plus head, tail and length on the list.", what does "reminder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reminder /rɪˈmaɪn.dər/ (danh từ): lời nhắc lại. "Quick reminder" = nhắc nhanh lại điều đã học; cụm hay gặp: "as a reminder".
items.explanationEn: reminder /rɪˈmaɪn.dər/ (noun): something that helps you remember. "Quick reminder" introduces a short recap of known material; also common: "as a reminder".

items.question: Trong câu "Quick reminder: a singly linked list is a chain of nodes where each node holds a value and a next pointer, plus head, tail and length on the list.", từ "chain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quick reminder: a singly linked list is a chain of nodes where each node holds a value and a next pointer, plus head, tail and length on the list.", what does "chain" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a group of shops with one owner
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (danh từ): chuỗi nối tiếp nhau. "A chain of nodes" = chuỗi các nút nối với nhau; cùng họ: "chained calls".
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (noun): a connected series of things. "A chain of nodes" means nodes connected one after another; related: "chained calls".

items.question: Trong câu "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", từ "identical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", what does "identical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giống hệt nhau. "Almost identical" = gần như giống hệt; cấu trúc: "identical to something".
items.explanationEn: identical /aɪˈden.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): exactly the same. "Almost identical" means nearly the same; pattern: "identical to something".

items.question: Trong câu "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", từ "except" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", what does "except" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: except /ɪkˈsept/ (giới từ): ngoại trừ. "Except (that)..." dùng để nêu điểm khác biệt duy nhất; biến thể: "except for".
items.explanationEn: except /ɪkˈsept/ (preposition): not including. "Except (that)..." points out the one difference; variant: "except for".

items.question: Trong câu "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", từ "carry" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A doubly linked list (DLL) is almost identical — except every node carries one more pointer, prev, to the node before it.", what does "carry" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: carry /ˈkær.i/ (động từ): chứa, mang theo. Trong lập trình, "a node carries a pointer" = nút chứa một con trỏ; cũng gặp "carry data".
items.explanationEn: carry /ˈkær.i/ (verb): to hold or contain. In programming, "a node carries a pointer" means it holds one; also "carry data".

items.question: Trong câu "From any node you can reach its predecessor in O(1), so removing the tail (and removing a node you already hold) becomes O(1).", từ "predecessor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "From any node you can reach its predecessor in O(1), so removing the tail (and removing a node you already hold) becomes O(1).", what does "predecessor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who held a job before
items.explanation: predecessor /ˈpriː.dɪ.ses.ər/ (danh từ): phần tử đứng trước. Trái nghĩa với "successor"; trong DLL, prev trỏ tới predecessor.
items.explanationEn: predecessor /ˈpriː.dɪ.ses.ər/ (noun): the item just before. The opposite of "successor"; in a DLL, prev points to the predecessor.

items.question: Trong câu "Lookups by index can start from whichever end is closer.", từ "lookup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lookups by index can start from whichever end is closer.", what does "lookup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of finding a value
items.explanation: lookup /ˈlʊk.ʌp/ (danh từ): sự tra cứu, tìm kiếm. Danh từ "lookup" viết liền; động từ là "look up". Cụm hay gặp: "O(1) lookup".
items.explanationEn: lookup /ˈlʊk.ʌp/ (noun): the act of finding a value. The noun "lookup" is one word; the verb is "look up". Common: "O(1) lookup".

items.question: Trong câu "More memory buys more flexibility — the usual trade-off.", từ "flexibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More memory buys more flexibility — the usual trade-off.", what does "flexibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flexibility /ˌflek.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính linh hoạt. "Buy flexibility" = đổi lấy sự linh hoạt; tính từ: "flexible".
items.explanationEn: flexibility /ˌflek.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the ability to adapt easily. "Buy flexibility" means gaining it at a cost; adjective: "flexible".

items.question: Trong câu "More memory buys more flexibility — the usual trade-off.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More memory buys more flexibility — the usual trade-off.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. Cụm rất hay gặp trong phỏng vấn: "time-space trade-off" (đánh đổi thời gian và bộ nhớ).
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two costs. Very common in interviews: "time-space trade-off".

items.question: Trong câu "The price is memory: every node stores an extra reference.", từ "price" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The price is memory: every node stores an extra reference.", what does "price" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: price /praɪs/ (danh từ): cái giá phải trả. Nghĩa bóng: "the price is X" = cái giá (bất lợi) phải chấp nhận là X.
items.explanationEn: price /praɪs/ (noun): a cost you must accept. Figurative use: "the price is X" means X is the downside you accept.

items.question: Trong câu "Three states every method must handle correctly:", từ "state" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three states every method must handle correctly:", what does "state" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (danh từ): trạng thái. Trong lập trình, "state" là trạng thái hiện tại của dữ liệu; cụm: "empty state".
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (noun): a condition something is in. In programming, "state" is the current condition of data; e.g. "empty state".

items.question: Trong câu "After every operation: head.prev === null, tail.next === null, and for every node a with a successor, a.next.prev === a.", từ "successor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After every operation: head.prev === null, tail.next === null, and for every node a with a successor, a.next.prev === a.", what does "successor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: successor /səkˈses.ər/ (danh từ): phần tử đứng sau. Trái nghĩa với "predecessor"; trong danh sách liên kết, next trỏ tới successor.
items.explanationEn: successor /səkˈses.ər/ (noun): the item just after. The opposite of "predecessor"; in a linked list, next points to the successor.

items.question: Trong câu "Most DLL bugs break the last rule — a link updated in one direction only.", từ "direction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most DLL bugs break the last rule — a link updated in one direction only.", what does "direction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: direction /daɪˈrek.ʃən/ (danh từ): chiều, hướng. "In one direction" = theo một chiều; ngược lại: "in both directions".
items.explanationEn: direction /daɪˈrek.ʃən/ (noun): a way something points. "In one direction" means one way only; opposite: "in both directions".

items.question: Trong câu "Increment length and return the list.", từ "increment" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Increment length and return the list.", what does "increment" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (động từ): tăng lên (thường thêm 1). Trái nghĩa: "decrement"; toán tử ++ dùng để increment một biến.
items.explanationEn: increment /ˈɪŋ.krə.ment/ (verb): to increase by a step. Opposite: "decrement"; the ++ operator increments a variable.

items.question: Trong câu "Otherwise link both ways: tail.next = node and node.prev = tail, then move tail to the node.", từ "link" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Otherwise link both ways: tail.next = node and node.prev = tail, then move tail to the node.", what does "link" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: link /lɪŋk/ (động từ): nối, liên kết. "Link both ways" = nối cả hai chiều; danh từ "link" = liên kết.
items.explanationEn: link /lɪŋk/ (verb): to connect together. "Link both ways" means connect in both directions; the noun "link" is a connection.

items.question: Trong câu "If the list is empty, the node becomes both head and tail.", từ "empty" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the list is empty, the node becomes both head and tail.", what does "empty" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: empty /ˈemp.ti/ (tính từ): rỗng, không có gì. "An empty list" = danh sách rỗng; nghĩa khác: "an empty promise" (lời hứa suông).
items.explanationEn: empty /ˈemp.ti/ (adjective): containing nothing. "An empty list" has no items; another sense: "an empty promise".

items.question: Trong câu "With prev, the new tail is simply tail.prev.", từ "simply" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With prev, the new tail is simply tail.prev.", what does "simply" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simply /ˈsɪm.pli/ (trạng từ): chỉ đơn giản là. "Simply X" nhấn mạnh việc dễ dàng; nghĩa khác: "dress simply" (ăn mặc giản dị).
items.explanationEn: simply /ˈsɪm.pli/ (adverb): just, merely. "Simply X" stresses how easy it is; another sense: "dress simply".

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting this.tail.next = null leaves the new tail still pointing at the removed node, so a forward traversal would "resurrect" it.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting this.tail.next = null leaves the new tail still pointing at the removed node, so a forward traversal would "resurrect" it.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua lần lượt. Động từ: "traverse"; cụm: "forward traversal" (duyệt xuôi), "backward traversal" (duyệt ngược).
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (noun): visiting items one by one. Verb: "traverse"; phrases: "forward traversal", "backward traversal".

items.question: Trong câu "Forgetting this.tail.next = null leaves the new tail still pointing at the removed node, so a forward traversal would "resurrect" it.", từ "resurrect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forgetting this.tail.next = null leaves the new tail still pointing at the removed node, so a forward traversal would "resurrect" it.", what does "resurrect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resurrect /ˌrez.əˈrekt/ (động từ): làm sống lại. Ở đây dùng nghĩa bóng: nút đã xóa lại "xuất hiện trở lại" khi duyệt danh sách.
items.explanationEn: resurrect /ˌrez.əˈrekt/ (verb): to bring back to life. Used figuratively here: a removed node "comes back" during traversal.

items.question: Trong câu "Clearing oldTail.prev is hygiene: the caller receives a clean node that does not hold the list in memory.", từ "hygiene" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clearing oldTail.prev is hygiene: the caller receives a clean node that does not hold the list in memory.", what does "hygiene" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hygiene /ˈhaɪ.dʒiːn/ (danh từ): thói quen dọn dẹp gọn. Nghĩa bóng trong lập trình: "code hygiene" = thói quen giữ mã sạch sẽ, gọn gàng.
items.explanationEn: hygiene /ˈhaɪ.dʒiːn/ (noun): good tidy-up practice. Figurative in programming: "code hygiene" means habits that keep code clean.

items.question: Trong câu "Clearing oldTail.prev is hygiene: the caller receives a clean node that does not hold the list in memory.", từ "caller" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clearing oldTail.prev is hygiene: the caller receives a clean node that does not hold the list in memory.", what does "caller" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person making a phone call
the code that calls a function
items.explanation: caller /ˈkɔː.lər/ (danh từ): đoạn mã gọi hàm. Trong lập trình, "the caller receives..." = nơi gọi hàm nhận được giá trị trả về.
items.explanationEn: caller /ˈkɔː.lər/ (noun): the code that calls a function. In programming, "the caller receives..." means the calling code gets the return value.

items.question: Trong câu "shift removes the first node; it is the mirror image of pop.", từ "mirror image" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "shift removes the first node; it is the mirror image of pop.", what does "mirror image" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˈɪm.ɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): bản đối xứng ngược lại. "X is the mirror image of Y" = X giống Y nhưng theo chiều ngược lại.
items.explanationEn: mirror image /ˈmɪr.ər ˈɪm.ɪdʒ/ (phrase): an exact reversed version. "X is the mirror image of Y" means X is like Y but reversed.

items.question: Trong câu "The length === 1 branch in shift/pop matters: without it, this.head.prev = null runs on null and throws, or tail keeps pointing at a removed node.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The length === 1 branch in shift/pop matters: without it, this.head.prev = null runs on null and throws, or tail keeps pointing at a removed node.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a local office of a company
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh rẽ trong mã. Trong lập trình, mỗi khối if/else là một "branch"; nghĩa khác: "a bank branch".
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (noun): a path in conditional code. In code, each if/else block is a "branch"; another sense: "a bank branch".

items.question: Trong câu "Both are O(1) time and space — unlike Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element is re-indexed.", từ "re-index" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are O(1) time and space — unlike Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element is re-indexed.", what does "re-index" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: re-index /ˌriːˈɪn.deks/ (động từ): đánh lại chỉ số. Tiền tố "re-" = làm lại; mảng phải re-index khi thêm/xóa ở đầu nên tốn O(n).
items.explanationEn: re-index /ˌriːˈɪn.deks/ (verb): to number positions again. The prefix "re-" means again; arrays re-index on front changes, costing O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "Both are O(1) time and space — unlike Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element is re-indexed.", từ "unlike" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are O(1) time and space — unlike Array.prototype.shift/unshift, which are O(n) because every element is re-indexed.", what does "unlike" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (giới từ): không giống như. "Unlike X, Y..." dùng để so sánh sự khác biệt; trái nghĩa: "like".
items.explanationEn: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (preposition): different from. "Unlike X, Y..." contrasts two things; opposite: "like".

items.question: Trong câu "A linked list has no indices, so get(index) must walk.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A linked list has no indices, so get(index) must walk.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list at the back of a book
the finger next to the thumb
items.explanation: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (danh từ): chỉ số vị trí. Số nhiều: "indices" hoặc "indexes"; cụm: "by index" (theo chỉ số).
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (noun): a position number. Plural: "indices" or "indexes"; phrase: "by index".

items.question: Trong câu "A linked list has no indices, so get(index) must walk.", từ "linked" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A linked list has no indices, so get(index) must walk.", what does "linked" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linked /lɪŋkt/ (tính từ): được nối với nhau. "A linked list" = danh sách mà các phần tử nối với nhau bằng con trỏ.
items.explanationEn: linked /lɪŋkt/ (adjective): connected together. "A linked list" is a list whose items are connected by pointers.

items.question: Trong câu "A DLL can at least walk from whichever end is closer:", từ "at least" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A DLL can at least walk from whichever end is closer:", what does "at least" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at least /æt liːst/ (cụm từ): ít nhất thì, dù sao. "At least" ở đây = ít ra còn có điểm tốt; nghĩa khác: "at least 8" (tối thiểu 8).
items.explanationEn: at least /æt liːst/ (phrase): anyway, in any case. "At least" here means there is some benefit; another sense: "at least 8" (minimum).

items.question: Trong câu "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. Big O thường mô tả "worst case"; cặp liên quan: "best case", "average case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (phrase): the most costly scenario. Big O usually describes the "worst case"; related: "best case", "average case".

items.question: Trong câu "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", từ "instead of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", what does "instead of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (cụm từ): thay vì. "X instead of Y" = chọn X, không phải Y.
items.explanationEn: instead of /ɪnˈsted əv/ (phrase): in place of. "X instead of Y" means X replaces Y.

items.question: Trong câu "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", từ "speed-up" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", what does "speed-up" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: speed-up /ˈspiːd.ʌp/ (danh từ): sự tăng tốc. "A real speed-up" = tăng tốc thực sự; động từ: "speed up".
items.explanationEn: speed-up /ˈspiːd.ʌp/ (noun): an increase in speed. "A real speed-up" is a genuine gain in speed; verb: "speed up".

items.question: Trong câu "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", từ "constant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The worst case is now about n/2 steps instead of n — a real speed-up, but still O(n), because constants are dropped.", what does "constant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (danh từ): hằng số. Trong Big O, "constants are dropped" = bỏ qua hằng số, nên n/2 vẫn là O(n).
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (noun): a fixed number factor. In Big O, "constants are dropped", so n/2 is still O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "set reuses get:", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "set reuses get:", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): tái sử dụng. "Reuse code" = dùng lại mã có sẵn thay vì viết lại; danh từ: "reuse".
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Reuse code" means using existing code instead of rewriting it; noun: "reuse".

items.question: Trong câu "If index < 0 or index > length, return false (note >, not >=: index === length means "append").", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If index < 0 or index > length, return false (note >, not >=: index === length means "append").", what does "append" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append to a list" = thêm vào cuối danh sách; trái với "prepend" (thêm vào đầu).
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. "Append to a list" means add at the end; opposite of "prepend".

items.question: Trong câu "If index < 0 or index > length, return false (note >, not >=: index === length means "append").", từ "note" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If index < 0 or index > length, return false (note >, not >=: index === length means "append").", what does "note" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: note /nəʊt/ (động từ): lưu ý, chú ý. "Note that..." = lưu ý rằng; nghĩa khác: "note down" (ghi lại).
items.explanationEn: note /nəʊt/ (verb): to pay attention to. "Note that..." draws attention to a detail; another sense: "note down".

items.question: Trong câu "Wire four pointers, then increment length.", từ "wire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (động từ): xử lý. "Handle a case" = xử lý một trường hợp; danh từ "handle" = tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhæn.dəl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handle a case" means deal with it; the noun "handle" is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "Trade-off: two pointers per node of extra memory for flexibility; sentinel nodes remove edge cases.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trade-off: two pointers per node of extra memory for flexibility; sentinel nodes remove edge cases.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên. "Edge cases" = các trường hợp đặc biệt ở biên như danh sách rỗng hoặc một nút.
items.explanationEn: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (phrase): an unusual boundary situation. "Edge cases" are boundary situations like an empty or one-node list.

items.question: Trong câu "Searching is O(n); walking from the nearer end halves the steps but not the Big O.", từ "halve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Searching is O(n); walking from the nearer end halves the steps but not the Big O.", what does "halve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: halve /hɑːv/ (động từ): giảm một nửa. Động từ của "half"; "halve the steps" = giảm số bước còn một nửa.
items.explanationEn: halve /hɑːv/ (verb): to cut in half. The verb form of "half"; "halve the steps" means cut them by 50%.

items.question: Trong câu "In insert, save after = before.next before rewiring; valid index range is 0..length.", từ "valid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In insert, save after = before.next before rewiring; valid index range is 0..length.", what does "valid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (tính từ): hợp lệ. "Valid index range" = khoảng chỉ số hợp lệ; trái nghĩa: "invalid".
items.explanationEn: valid /ˈvæl.ɪd/ (adjective): acceptable, allowed. "Valid index range" is the allowed set of indices; opposite: "invalid".

items.question: Trong câu "Real uses include browser history, deques, playlists and the classic hash map + DLL LRU cache.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real uses include browser history, deques, playlists and the classic hash map + DLL LRU cache.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): kinh điển. "The classic X" = X kinh điển, ví dụ tiêu biểu nhất; khác với "classical".
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): well known and typical. "The classic X" is the standard example; different from "classical".
